by: Claude Code (opus), titles and abstracts only

question.outcome: Results of immunoassay blood tests (thyroid, troponin, hormones): falsely high or low

decisions.reason: Systematic literature review of biotin intake causing falsely high or low thyroid and other immunoassay results, alongside a case report.
Pooled RCTs of high-dose biotin vs placebo with separate analyses for progressive MS on disability (EDSS) and 25-foot walk outcomes.

question.outcome: Blood sugar, HbA1c or blood fats

decisions.reason: Pooled five RCTs of biotin supplements in adults with type 2 diabetes, reporting fasting glucose, HbA1c and blood lipids.
Covers biotin for glycemic control in adult type 2 diabetes, but summarises earlier meta-analyses instead of pooling trials and does not cover blood fats.
